recipes.title: Warm Japanese Shiso (Yukari), Soft Egg & Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Beloved Japanese morning comfort bowl tossing steaming rice with fragrant dried red shiso flakes or fresh shredded shiso, a soft egg, and sesame seeds.

ingredient_details.item: dried shiso flakes (yukari) or 4 fresh shredded shiso leaves
steaming cooked short-grain or jasmine rice

steps: Fluff hot rice in a bowl and fold in dried shiso flakes (or fresh thinly sliced shiso leaves) and toasted sesame seeds.
Nestle a warm soft-cooked egg right in the center.
Drizzle with toasted sesame oil, top with scallions, and eat warm with a spoon.
tips: In Japan, sprinkling aromatic purple shiso (yukari) over warm morning rice is an everyday staple.
Soft, hydrating, and effortless to chew.

recipes.title: Soothing Shiso, Ginger & Rice Morning Congee
recipes.summary: Velvety warm rice porridge simmered with fresh ginger and broth, finished with fragrant strips of fresh green shiso or dried shiso flakes.

ingredient_details.item: dried shiso leaves (or 6 fresh shiso leaves, thinly sliced)

steps: Simmer cooked rice, broth, and grated ginger in a saucepan 15 minutes until silky and porridge-soft.
Ladle into warm bowls and stir in shiso so the steam releases its bright mint-basil-citrus perfume.
Top with toasted sesame oil and sliced scallions.
tips: Shiso's bright herbal aroma wakes up mild morning congee with zero heaviness.
Add flaked poached salmon or silken tofu for extra protein.

recipes.title: Creamy Avocado, Lemon & Fresh Shiso Toast
recipes.summary: Toasted whole-grain bread layered with lemon-mashed avocado, fragrant shredded shiso leaves, sesame seeds, and a drop of olive oil.

ingredient_details.item: fresh green or red shiso leaves (or 1/2 tsp dried flakes)

steps: Mash ripe avocado with fresh lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Spread generously onto warm whole-grain toast.
Scatter finely snipped shiso, toasted sesame seeds, and a tiny drizzle of olive oil across the top.
tips: Shiso brings a refreshing mint-citrus lift that pairs wonderfully with buttery avocado.
Kitchen shears snip shiso leaves into neat ribbons effortlessly.

recipes.title: Fluffy Japanese-Style Shiso & Scallion Folded Omelet
recipes.summary: Silky low-heat folded omelet scented with finely sliced fresh shiso or dried shiso flakes, scallions, and light rice bran oil.

ingredient_details.item: fresh shiso leaves, finely snipped (or 3/4 tsp dried)

steps: Whisk eggs with soy sauce, 1 tbsp water, snipped shiso, and sliced scallions.
Warm oil over medium-low heat and pour in the egg mixture.
Cook gently 3 minutes, folding softly into tender layers, and slide onto a warm plate.
tips: A tablespoon of water makes folded omelets extra pillowy and gentle to eat.
Serve with sliced cucumber or warm rice.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt, Sweet Plum & Shiso Tea Honey Bowl
recipes.summary: Cool plain Greek yogurt topped with ripe sliced plum or berries, toasted oats, and a rosy drizzle of honey steeped with red shiso.

ingredient_details.item: dried red shiso leaves (or 3 fresh leaves)

steps: Steep shiso leaves in 2 tbsp hot water with honey and lemon juice 3 minutes until rosy-fragrant, then strain.
Spoon Greek yogurt into a bowl and arrange sliced ripe plum and toasted oats on top.
Drizzle the sweet floral shiso syrup across the bowl and enjoy.
tips: A few drops of lemon juice turn red shiso infusion a gorgeous vibrant magenta.
Ripe peaches or strawberries pair equally well with shiso.

recipes.title: Chilled Buckwheat Soba, Cucumber & Fresh Shiso Bowl
recipes.summary: Classic cooling Japanese lunch pairing tender buckwheat soba noodles, crisp cucumber, shelled edamame, light soy-vinegar dressing, and bright shiso.

ingredient_details.item: fresh shiso leaves, finely sliced (or 1.5 tsp dried)

steps: Boil soba noodles 5 to 6 minutes until tender, rinse thoroughly under cold water, and drain well.
Whisk soy sauce, rice vinegar, toasted sesame oil, and 2 tbsp cold water in a bowl.
Toss chilled noodles, cucumber, edamame, and fragrant shiso with the dressing and serve cool.
tips: Shiso is the signature cooling summer herb for Japanese chilled soba and somen noodles.
Snip noodles briefly with kitchen shears for effortless fork pickup.

recipes.title: Chilled Hiyayakko Silken Tofu with Ginger & Shiso
recipes.summary: Classic Japanese no-cook protein lunch plating pillowy chilled silken tofu over cucumber and rice, crowned with fresh ginger, scallions, soy sauce, and shiso.

ingredient_details.item: fresh shiso leaves, thinly sliced (or 1 tsp dried)

steps: Arrange chilled silken tofu blocks neatly alongside crisp cucumber slices in two shallow bowls.
Mound grated fresh ginger, sliced scallions, and fragrant shiso across the top of the tofu.
Drizzle lightly with soy sauce and toasted sesame oil and eat gently with a spoon.
tips: Hiyayakko requires zero heat, takes 6 minutes, and offers custard-soft plant protein that is effortless to swallow.
Serve with a small bowl of warm rice on the side.

recipes.title: Poached Salmon, Cucumber & Shiso Sushi-Style Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Fresh chirashi-inspired lunch bowl layering lightly vinegared rice, tender flaked poached salmon, avocado, cucumber, and fragrant shiso.

ingredient_details.item: fresh shiso leaves, thinly sliced (or 1.5 tsp dried yukari)
warm cooked short-grain or jasmine rice

steps: Fold rice vinegar and half the shiso gently into warm cooked rice and divide between two bowls.
Top neatly with moist flakes of poached salmon, cubed avocado, and diced cucumber.
Finish with remaining shiso and toasted sesame seeds.
tips: Shiso and salmon are one of Japanese cuisine's brightest omega-3 partnerships.
Ready in 8 minutes using pre-poached salmon.

recipes.title: Light Shiso, Mushroom & Baby Spinach Miso Soup
recipes.summary: Restorative clear miso broth simmering tender mushrooms, soft tofu, and spinach, lifted right at serving with aromatic shredded shiso.

ingredient_details.item: fresh shiso leaves, thinly sliced (or 1.5 tsp dried)
thinly sliced shiitake or cremini mushrooms

steps: Simmer water, sliced mushrooms, and grated ginger 7 minutes until mushrooms turn tender.
Turn heat off, slip in cubed soft tofu and baby spinach, and whisk miso smooth in a ladleful of warm broth before returning it to the pot.
Ladle into warm bowls and crown generously with fragrant shiso right before sipping.
tips: Adding shiso at the very end preserves its bright citrus-mint perfume in steaming broth.
Soothing, hydrating, and completely plant-based.

recipes.title: Poached Chicken, Crisp Pear & Shiso Lettuce Wraps
recipes.summary: Tender shredded poached chicken, sweet diced pear, and cucumber dressed in light lime-sesame vinaigrette with fragrant shiso inside tender lettuce leaves.

ingredient_details.item: fresh shiso leaves (or 1.5 tsp dried flakes)

steps: Whisk lime juice, toasted sesame oil, and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Toss shredded poached chicken, finely diced pear, diced cucumber, and finely snipped shiso with the dressing.
Spoon into soft butter lettuce cups (or tuck into a warm whole-wheat tortilla) and serve cool.
tips: If you have large fresh green shiso leaves, you can even tuck a whole leaf right inside each butter lettuce cup as a fragrant wrapper.
Crisp, refreshing, and dairy-free.

recipes.title: Tender Japanese Shiso & Ginger Chicken Tsukune Patties
recipes.summary: Juicy, pillow-soft ground chicken patties mixed with finely shredded shiso, grated ginger, and scallions, glazed gently with light soy-honey sauce.

ingredient_details.item: fresh shiso leaves, finely chopped (or 2 tsp dried)

steps: Mix ground chicken, chopped shiso, grated ginger, scallions, and 1 tbsp soy sauce gently into 6 soft oval patties.
Sear patties in oil over medium heat 3 minutes per side, then add remaining 1 tbsp soy sauce, honey, and 3 tbsp water; cover and steam-glaze 5 minutes until 165 F.
Serve warm over steamed rice with pan glaze spooned over top.
tips: Adding a splash of water and covering the skillet guarantees extraordinarily moist, soft patties.
Traditional Japanese shiso tsukune is a crowd favorite for both weeknights and meal prep.

recipes.title: Foil-Steamed Salmon with Fresh Shiso, Lemon & Mushrooms
recipes.summary: Moist parchment-steamed Japanese salmon packets layered with thinly sliced mushrooms, lemon, light soy sauce, and fragrant shiso leaves.

ingredient_details.item: fresh shiso leaves (or 1.5 tsp dried flakes)
thinly sliced shiitake or cremini mushrooms

steps: Heat oven to 400 F. Lay sliced mushrooms on two squares of parchment paper and set a salmon fillet atop each.
Top each fillet with shiso, a lemon slice, half the soy sauce, and oil, then fold parchment edges tightly into sealed packets.
Bake 13 to 14 minutes until salmon is steaming and fork-tender, opening packets carefully at the table.
tips: Parchment steaming locks in every drop of omega-3 moisture and shiso aroma with virtually zero dishwashing.
Serve with warm jasmine rice or soft noodles.

recipes.title: Wafu Japanese Shiso, Basil & Edamame Olive Oil Pasta
recipes.summary: Tokyo-style wafu short pasta tossed with sweet cherry tomatoes, shelled edamame, garlic olive oil, a splash of soy sauce, and bright shiso.

ingredient_details.item: fresh shiso leaves, thinly shredded (or 2 tsp dried)

steps: Boil short pasta per package directions, adding frozen edamame during the last 3 minutes; reserve 1/3 cup pasta water.
Gently warm olive oil, sliced garlic, and cherry tomatoes in a skillet 4 minutes until tomatoes soften.
Toss drained pasta, edamame, soy sauce, and pasta water into the skillet, turn off heat, and fold in generous fragrant shiso.
tips: Wafu (Japanese-style) pasta with garlic, soy sauce, and fresh shiso is wildly popular across Japan for good reason.
Completely plant-based and ready in under 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Soft Miso-Glazed Eggplant, Tofu & Shiso Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Custard-soft roasted Japanese eggplant and golden tofu glazed with sweet white miso and finished with bright ribbons of fresh shiso.

ingredient_details.item: fresh shiso leaves, thinly sliced (or 1.5 tsp dried)

steps: Heat oven to 400 F; toss cubed eggplant and tofu with oil on a parchment-lined sheet pan and roast 15 minutes until soft and lightly golden.
Drizzle thinned white miso and grated ginger over the tray and roast 3 more minutes to glaze.
Pile over bowls of warm rice and shower generously with bright aromatic shiso.
tips: Bright herbal shiso cuts cleanly through rich sweet miso and velvety eggplant.
Naturally dairy-free and very gentle to chew.

recipes.title: Ginger, Shiso & Clear Broth Poached Cod with Bok Choy
recipes.summary: Clean, delicate white fish fillets and baby bok choy poached in ginger-soy broth and finished generously with aromatic shiso leaves.

ingredient_details.item: fresh shiso leaves, thinly sliced (or 1.5 tsp dried)

steps: Simmer vegetable broth, soy sauce, and grated ginger in a wide skillet for 2 minutes.
Nestle cod fillets and baby bok choy into the gentle broth, cover, and poach 8 minutes until fish flakes softly.
Plate into shallow bowls, drizzle toasted sesame oil, and crown with bright shiso right before serving.
tips: Light, clean, and calming for evening meals.
Serve over warm short-grain rice or soft udon noodles.

recipes.title: Ruby Raspberry, Blueberry & Shiso Botanical Smoothie
recipes.summary: Antioxidant-rich berry smoothie uniting frozen blueberries, raspberries, Greek yogurt, milk, and fragrant shiso leaves.

ingredient_details.item: fresh red or green shiso leaves (or 1/2 tsp dried)

steps: Combine milk, Greek yogurt, shiso, frozen blueberries, frozen raspberries, and honey in a blender.
Blend 50 seconds until smooth, vibrant purple-red, and fragrant.
Pour into a chilled glass and enjoy immediately.
tips: Red shiso (akajiso) shares the same rich purple anthocyanin pigments as dark berries.
Tastes bright, floral, and clean—like berries with a hint of mint and citrus.

recipes.title: Japanese Peach, Ginger & Shiso Oat-Milk Smoothie
recipes.summary: Velvety dairy-free smoothie pairing sweet frozen peaches, oat milk, fresh ginger, lemon, and delicate aromatic shiso.
steps: Place oat milk, shiso, frozen peach slices, grated ginger, and lemon juice in a blender.
Blend 50 seconds until pale sunset-gold and silky smooth.
Serve cold right away.
tips: Sweet white or yellow peaches harmonize effortlessly with shiso's minty-floral character.
Naturally dairy-free and caffeine-free.

recipes.title: Crisp Pear, Baby Spinach & Green Shiso Smoothie
recipes.summary: Refreshing Japanese garden green smoothie blending juicy ripe pear, baby spinach, banana, shiso, lemon, and cold water.

ingredient_details.item: fresh green shiso leaves (or 1/2 tsp dried)

steps: Blend cold water, baby spinach, and shiso 20 seconds until bright green and liquefied.
Add diced ripe pear, frozen banana, and lemon juice and blend 35 seconds until silky and frosty.
Pour into a tall glass and sip crisp.
tips: Green shiso (aoba) turns everyday spinach-pear smoothies bright, crisp, and cooling.
Hydrating, dairy-free, and nut-free.

recipes.title: Sweet Strawberry, Banana & Shiso Silk Smoothie
recipes.summary: Rosy everyday smoothie blending frozen strawberries, banana, almond milk, plain yogurt, and bright aromatic shiso.
steps: Combine almond milk, Greek yogurt, shiso, frozen strawberries, and banana in a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until rosy, frosty, and smooth.
Serve cold immediately.
tips: Shiso works like sweet basil or mint in strawberry smoothies—just more complex and citrusy.
Zero added sweetener needed.

recipes.title: Golden Mango, Pineapple & Shiso Tropical Smoothie
recipes.summary: Sunny tropical smoothie uniting frozen mango, pineapple, coconut water, lime juice, and fragrant shiso.
steps: Add coconut water, shiso, frozen mango, frozen pineapple, and lime juice to a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until bright golden and smooth.
Pour into a chilled glass and enjoy immediately.
tips: A light, electrolyte-rich tropical cooler with zero dairy.
Add 2 tbsp plain yogurt if you'd like extra creaminess.

recipes.title: Traditional Japanese Ruby Shiso & Lemon Juice (Shiso Juusu)
recipes.summary: Iconic Japanese summer tonic gently simmering red or green shiso leaves, then brightening with fresh lemon juice and honey until jewel-bright over ice.

ingredient_details.item: packed fresh red or green shiso leaves (or 2 tbsp dried shiso)

steps: Bring water to a gentle boil, add shiso leaves, and simmer softly 6 to 8 minutes until deeply aromatic.
Strain out the leaves cleanly and stir honey and freshly squeezed lemon juice into the warm infusion—watching red shiso magically glow ruby-red.
Chill completely and serve over tall glasses of ice.
tips: Japanese families brew pitchers of shiso juusu every summer to stay cool, hydrated, and refreshed.
Keeps 5 days chilled in the refrigerator and tastes great splashed with sparkling water.

recipes.title: Crisp Cucumber, Lime & Shiso Spa Cooler
recipes.summary: Cooling garden press blending chopped cucumber, cold water, bright lime juice, and shiso leaves, strained silky smooth over ice.

ingredient_details.item: fresh green shiso leaves (or 3/4 tsp dried)

steps: Blend chopped cucumber, chilled water, lime juice, honey, and shiso 20 seconds.
Strain through a fine-mesh sieve into a glass filled with ice.
Sip cold and crisp right away.
tips: Refreshing like a spa drink with shiso's unique cinnamon-mint-citrus finish.
Skip honey for a completely sugar-free botanical press.

recipes.title: Orchard Apple, Ginger & Brewed Shiso Iced Tonic
recipes.summary: Crisp pressed apple juice layered with chilled steeped shiso tea, fresh ginger juice, and bright lemon over ice.
steps: Steep shiso in hot water covered 4 minutes, then strain cleanly.
Pour the fragrant shiso infusion, pressed apple juice, ginger juice, and lemon juice over ice cubes.
Stir gently and enjoy chilled.
tips: Naturally sweet from apple juice with a lively aromatic finish.
Caffeine-free and soothing any afternoon.

recipes.title: Chilled Watermelon, Lime & Shiso Summer Press
recipes.summary: Jewel-red seedless watermelon juice blended briefly with fragrant shiso leaves and fresh lime, strained crystal smooth.

ingredient_details.item: fresh red or green shiso leaves (or 1 tsp dried)

steps: Blend watermelon cubes, lime juice, chilled water, and shiso 20 seconds.
Strain through a fine sieve into two ice-filled glasses.
Serve immediately while frosty and crisp.
tips: Watermelon and shiso are a wildly refreshing Japanese summer favorite.
Zero added sweetener and deeply hydrating.

recipes.title: Sparkling Pear, Citrus & Steeped Shiso Refresher
recipes.summary: Light sparkling mocktail pairing chilled brewed shiso tea, pure pear juice, lemon-lime juice, and bubbly water.
steps: Steep shiso in 1/3 cup hot water covered 4 minutes and strain cleanly.
Pour the strained infusion, pear juice, lemon juice, and lime juice over ice cubes.
Top with sparkling water, stir lightly, and serve cold.
tips: Combining lemon and lime juice mimics Japanese yuzu citrus alongside delicate shiso.
Festive, crisp, and completely alcohol- and caffeine-free.

recipes.title: Japanese Shiso, Warm Barley, Flaked Salmon & Sesame Oil Morning Bowl
recipes.summary: Nourishing Japanese-style breakfast grain bowl folding steaming pearl barley with flaked salmon, finely diced celery stalk, grated ginger, fresh shredded shiso, and toasted sesame oil.

ingredient_details.item: fresh green or red shiso leaves, thinly sliced (or 1 tsp dried yukari)

steps: Warm cooked pearl barley with finely diced celery stalk and 2 tbsp water 3 minutes until steamy and celery is crisp-tender.
Fold in flaked salmon, grated fresh ginger, soy sauce, and half the shredded shiso leaves.
Transfer to a breakfast bowl, drizzle with toasted sesame oil, and scatter remaining fragrant shiso on top.
tips: Swapping pearl barley for white rice keeps the classic Japanese morning salmon bowl texture while adding gentle soluble fiber.
Fresh shiso adds an effortless mint-citrus brightness that wakes up savory fish.

recipes.title: Wafu Shiso, Ginger Chicken & Cilantro Soft Egg Scramble
recipes.summary: Cloud-soft low-heat scrambled eggs cooked in neutral rice bran oil with tender shredded chicken, grated ginger, cracked black pepper, fresh cilantro, and bright shiso ribbons.

ingredient_details.item: fresh green shiso leaves, finely snipped (or 1 tsp dried)

steps: Warm rice bran oil over medium-low heat and sauté grated fresh ginger with shredded chicken and black pepper 2 minutes until aromatic.
Pour in beaten eggs and fold gently 3 minutes until soft curds are just set.
Remove from heat, fold in fresh snipped shiso and chopped cilantro, and serve right away.
tips: Adding shiso and cilantro off the heat preserves their bright emerald color and delicate aroma.
Rice bran oil heats cleanly without masking gentle herbal flavors.

recipes.title: Red Shiso, Sweet Orange, Blueberry & Flaxseed Oil Yogurt Parfait
recipes.summary: Cool creamy Greek yogurt layered with wild blueberries, sliced banana, sweet orange segments, smooth flaxseed oil, and a lightly steeped ruby shiso drizzle.

ingredient_details.item: fresh red or green shiso leaves (or 1 tsp dried shiso)
hot water for brief shiso steep

steps: Steep shiso leaves in 3 tbsp hot water 3 minutes with a squeeze of juice from the orange, then strain to get a jewel-tinted herbal infusion.
Stir cold-pressed flaxseed oil smoothly into plain Greek yogurt in a chilled bowl.
Top with sliced banana, wild blueberries, diced sweet orange, and spoon the cooled shiso infusion over the fruit.
tips: A drop of citrus juice turns red shiso infusion a brilliant magenta naturally.
Swirling flaxseed oil right into yogurt makes it silky and effortless to enjoy.

recipes.title: Silky Shiso, Pearl Barley, Ginger & Celery Morning Porridge
recipes.summary: Soothing savory morning porridge simmering cooked pearl barley with finely diced celery stalk, fresh ginger, golden turmeric, and black pepper, crowned with shredded shiso and toasted sesame oil.

ingredient_details.item: fresh shiso leaves, thinly sliced (or 1 tsp dried shiso)

steps: Simmer cooked pearl barley, finely diced celery stalk, vegetable broth, grated ginger, turmeric, and black pepper 12 to 14 minutes until soft and velvety.
Ladle the golden porridge into warm bowls.
Finish each bowl with fresh shredded shiso leaves and a fragrant drizzle of toasted sesame oil.
tips: Warm steam blooms shiso's refreshing mint-basil perfume right at the table.
Easy to swallow, deeply hydrating, and gentle on morning digestion.

recipes.title: Aromatic Shiso, Warm Tofu, Orange & Sichuan Pepper Breakfast Toast
recipes.summary: Golden pan-warmed tofu cubes sautéed in rice bran oil with mild floral Sichuan pepper, sweet orange zest, cilantro, toasted sesame oil, and fresh shiso over whole-grain toast.

ingredient_details.item: fresh green shiso leaves, thinly sliced

ingredient_details.note: patted dry and crumbled into soft bites

ingredient_details.item: fresh orange zest plus 1 tsp juice

steps: Warm rice bran oil in a small skillet and gently sauté crumbled tofu 4 minutes until lightly golden and soft inside.
Stir in toasted ground Sichuan pepper, orange zest, orange juice, and toasted sesame oil for 30 seconds off the heat.
Pile onto warm whole-grain toast and crown with fresh cilantro and shredded green shiso.
tips: A tiny pinch of floral Sichuan pepper delivers citrusy aroma rather than fiery heat.
Plant-protein morning toast that comes together in 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Steaming Shiso, Flaked Salmon, Barley & Black Tea Ochazuke
recipes.summary: Comforting Japanese tea-broth grain bowl pouring light brewed black tea over warm pearl barley, tender flaked salmon, fresh ginger threads, toasted sesame oil, and torn shiso.

ingredient_details.item: fresh green or red shiso leaves, shredded (or 1 tsp dried yukari)
mild black tea bag (or decaf black tea)
finely julienned or grated fresh ginger

steps: Steep the black tea bag in 1 cup hot water for 2 minutes for a light, mellow golden tea, then remove the bag.
Mound warm cooked pearl barley in a deep bowl and top with flaked salmon, fresh ginger, and shredded shiso leaves.
Pour the hot black tea gently around the edge of the bowl, finish with toasted sesame oil, and eat warm with a spoon.
tips: Japanese ochazuke turns leftover salmon and cooked grains into a restorative 10-minute lunch.
Brewing the tea briefly keeps it delicate and free of astringency.

recipes.title: Chilled Shiso, Poached Chicken, Celery & Cilantro Sesame Soba
recipes.summary: Cool refreshing buckwheat soba noodles tossed with shredded chicken, crisp finely sliced celery stalk, fresh cilantro, green shiso ribbons, and an orange-ginger sesame oil dressing.

ingredient_details.item: fresh green shiso leaves, finely ribboned

steps: Cook soba noodles 5 minutes until tender, drain, and rinse thoroughly under cold water so they stay silky and separate.
Whisk toasted sesame oil, fresh orange juice, grated ginger, and 1 tbsp water in a mixing bowl.
Toss chilled soba with shredded chicken, sliced celery stalk, fresh cilantro, shiso ribbons, and the sesame-orange dressing.
tips: Rinsing cooked soba in cold water removes excess starch for a clean, springy noodle bowl.
Shiso and cilantro together give a vivid garden freshness with every forkful.

recipes.title: Fragrant Shiso, Sichuan Pepper Salmon, Celery & Rice Bran Oil Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Warm lunchtime rice bowl folding flaked salmon and crisp diced celery stalk gently warmed in rice bran oil with mild floral Sichuan pepper, fresh ginger, and shredded shiso.

ingredient_details.item: fresh shiso leaves, finely sliced (or 1 tsp dried yukari)
warm cooked jasmine or short-grain rice

steps: Warm rice bran oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté diced celery stalk with grated ginger 3 minutes until crisp-tender.
Fold in flaked salmon and ground toasted Sichuan pepper for 2 minutes until warm and citrus-fragrant.
Spoon over bowls of steaming rice and shower generously with fresh shredded shiso.
tips: Toasting Sichuan peppercorns briefly before grinding unlocks bright lemony aroma with gentle, pleasant tingle.
Pairs effortlessly with steamed edamame or cucumber slices on the side.

recipes.title: Crisp Shiso, Chilled Chicken, Cantaloupe & Grape Sesame Salad
recipes.summary: Cool no-cook summer lunch combining tender poached chicken, sweet cantaloupe cubes, halved seedless grapes, torn fresh shiso, spearmint, and toasted sesame oil.

ingredient_details.item: fresh green or red shiso leaves, torn
fresh spearmint leaves, torn (or 1/2 tsp dried)

steps: Whisk toasted sesame oil, fresh lime juice, and a pinch of salt in a large bowl.
Add chilled diced chicken, ripe cantaloupe cubes, and halved grapes and toss gently to coat.
Fold in torn fresh shiso and spearmint right before serving so the herbs stay crisp and vivid.
tips: No stove required—hydrating melon and grapes make this lunch refreshing on warm days.
Shiso and spearmint belong to the same botanical family and layer together seamlessly.

recipes.title: Garden Shiso, Warm Barley, Sweet Basil & Celery Midday Bowl
recipes.summary: Herb-packed plant-based grain bowl layering warm pearl barley, tender edamame, diced celery stalk, ribbons of green shiso and sweet basil, grated ginger, rice bran oil, and sesame oil.
steps: Whisk rice bran oil, toasted sesame oil, grated ginger, and 1 tbsp warm water until glossy.
Toss warm cooked pearl barley, shelled edamame, and finely diced celery stalk with the ginger dressing.
Fold in fresh green shiso ribbons and torn sweet basil and serve lightly warm.
tips: Pairing Japanese shiso with sweet basil creates an aromatic double-herb lift over nutty barley.
Frozen shelled edamame thaws in 2 minutes under hot tap water for zero-effort plant protein.

recipes.title: Pan-Seared Shiso, Sweet Orange, Ginger & Rice Bran Oil Salmon
recipes.summary: Tender salmon fillets lightly seared in rice bran oil and spooned with a bright pan glaze of fresh orange juice, grated ginger, cracked black pepper, and toasted sesame oil under shredded shiso.

ingredient_details.item: fresh green or red shiso leaves, thinly ribboned
freshly squeezed orange juice plus 1 tsp zest

steps: Season salmon fillets with black pepper and sear in rice bran oil over medium heat 4 minutes per side until flaky and golden.
Lower heat and pour in fresh orange juice, orange zest, and grated ginger; simmer 90 seconds, spooning the glossy citrus sauce over the fish.
Plate the salmon, drizzle with toasted sesame oil, and crown generously with fresh shiso ribbons.
tips: Rice bran oil's high smoke point sears salmon cleanly without scorching.
Serve over steamed rice or pearl barley to catch the bright orange-ginger pan juices.

recipes.title: Mild Shiso, Sichuan Pepper Chicken, Celery & Ginger Soft Skillet
recipes.summary: Quick stovetop stir-braise of tender diced chicken and diagonal-sliced celery stalk scented with mild citrusy Sichuan pepper, ginger, rice bran oil, cilantro, and fresh shiso.

ingredient_details.item: fresh green shiso leaves, coarsely torn
boneless skinless chicken breast or thighs

steps: Warm rice bran oil over medium-high heat and cook chicken strips 5 minutes until golden and cooked through, then add grated ginger and toasted ground Sichuan pepper for 30 seconds.
Toss in diagonal-sliced celery stalks and chicken broth; cover 3 minutes so celery turns bright green and fork-tender.
Remove from heat, fold in torn fresh shiso and cilantro leaves, and serve immediately.
tips: Steaming celery briefly in broth keeps it crisp-tender and gentle to chew.
Using floral Sichuan pepper without chili oil gives fragrant lift without harsh spice.

recipes.title: Restorative Shiso, Golden Turmeric Barley & Poached Salmon Pot
recipes.summary: Soothing one-pot dinner simmering pearl barley, finely sliced celery stalk, fresh ginger, golden turmeric, and black pepper in broth, gently poaching salmon chunks right on top before scattering shiso.

ingredient_details.item: fresh green or red shiso leaves, thinly shredded

steps: Simmer rinsed pearl barley, sliced celery stalks, grated ginger, turmeric, black pepper, and vegetable broth covered 18 minutes until barley is tender.
Nestle salmon chunks right on top of the simmering golden barley, re-cover, and poach gently 5 to 6 minutes until salmon flakes effortlessly.
Ladle into shallow bowls and shower with bright fresh shredded shiso.
tips: Poaching salmon directly in the steam of simmering barley guarantees ultra-moist, tender fish.
One pot means easy cleanup and soothing spoon-ready comfort.

recipes.title: Ruby Shiso, Sweet Cherry, Ginger & Sesame Oil Skillet Chicken
recipes.summary: Juicy skillet chicken cutlets seared in rice bran oil and simmered briefly with halved sweet cherries, fresh ginger, and toasted sesame oil, topped with fragrant shiso leaves.

ingredient_details.item: fresh red or green shiso leaves, ribboned

steps: Sear thin chicken cutlets in rice bran oil over medium heat 3 minutes per side until lightly golden.
Add halved cherries, grated fresh ginger, and chicken broth; simmer uncovered 6 minutes until chicken reaches 165°F (74°C) and the sauce turns glossy.
Turn off heat, swirl in toasted sesame oil, and top with vibrant fresh shiso ribbons.
tips: Red shiso echoes the natural ruby color of sweet cherries for a gorgeous, fragrant weeknight supper.
Thawed frozen pitted cherries work year-round with zero prep.

recipes.title: Herbal Shiso, Cilantro & Basil Braised Tofu over Pearl Barley
recipes.summary: Tender braised tofu cubes simmered in light ginger-broth with a whisper of Sichuan pepper and toasted sesame oil, showered with fresh shiso, cilantro, and sweet basil over warm pearl barley.
steps: Simmer tofu cubes in vegetable broth with grated ginger and toasted ground Sichuan pepper covered 7 minutes until tender and infused.
Remove from heat and drizzle with toasted sesame oil.
Spoon the braised tofu and aromatic broth over warm pearl barley and top abundantly with torn shiso, cilantro, and sweet basil.
tips: Braising tofu instead of deep-frying keeps every cube cloud-soft and gentle to chew.
Three bright culinary herbs transform pantry tofu into a fragrant garden supper.

recipes.title: Ruby Shiso, Crushed Raspberry, Banana & Flaxseed Oil Velvet Smoothie
recipes.summary: Vibrant jewel-pink smoothie blending fresh shiso leaves, frozen raspberries, ripe banana, freshly squeezed orange juice, oat milk, and cold-pressed flaxseed oil.

ingredient_details.item: fresh red or green shiso leaves (rinsed and stemmed)

steps: Pour oat milk and freshly squeezed orange juice into the blender first so the blades spin smoothly.
Add fresh shiso leaves, frozen raspberries, ripe banana, and cold-pressed flaxseed oil.
Blend on high 50 seconds until completely velvety and jewel-pink, then pour into a chilled glass.
tips: Fresh shiso leaves are tender and blend cleanly without fibrous strings.
Strain briefly through a fine sieve if you prefer a seed-free raspberry finish.

recipes.title: Purple Shiso, Wild Blueberry, Dark Cherry & Ginger Smoothie
recipes.summary: Deep antioxidant smoothie combining fresh shiso, wild blueberries, pitted dark sweet cherries, ripe banana, grated ginger, Greek yogurt, and cold-pressed flaxseed oil.

ingredient_details.item: fresh red or green shiso leaves

steps: Combine chilled water, plain Greek yogurt, fresh shiso leaves, and grated ginger in a blender.
Add frozen blueberries, frozen cherries, ripe banana, and flaxseed oil.
Blend 50 seconds until deep violet, thick, and smooth; serve right away.
tips: Shiso's bright mint-clove aroma lifts dark berries and cherries with subtle sophistication.
Packs protein, polyphenols, and plant omega-3s into one easy-to-sip glass.

recipes.title: Sunlit Shiso, Sweet Cantaloupe, Orange & Spearmint Silk Smoothie
recipes.summary: Cooling coral-orange smoothie blending chilled sweet cantaloupe, fresh orange juice, tender shiso leaves, fresh spearmint, and mild grated ginger over ice.
steps: Pour freshly squeezed orange juice into the blender and add fresh shiso leaves, spearmint leaves, and grated ginger.
Top with chilled cantaloupe cubes and ice cubes.
Blend 45 seconds until frosty, silky, and aromatic; enjoy immediately.
tips: Naturally hydrating and completely dairy-free with crisp garden freshness.
Ripe summer cantaloupe delivers velvety body without needing banana or added sugar.

recipes.title: Velvet Red Shiso, Sweet Cherry, Banana & Dark Chocolate Smoothie
recipes.summary: Rich yet light afternoon treat uniting steeped red shiso infusion, frozen sweet cherries, ripe banana, finely chopped dark chocolate, warm cinnamon, and creamy milk.

ingredient_details.item: fresh red shiso leaves (or 1 tsp dried red shiso)

steps: Steep red shiso in hot water 3 minutes, strain cleanly, and stir in the finely chopped dark chocolate until mostly melted.
Pour the warm chocolate-shiso infusion into a blender with cold milk, frozen cherries, ripe banana, and cinnamon.
Blend 45 seconds until thick, cold, and silky smooth.
tips: Melting dark chocolate into the hot strained shiso tea creates a velvety cocoa swirl without gritty bits.
Subtle herbal notes give classic cherry-chocolate an unexpected Tokyo-cafe elegance.

recipes.title: Garden Shiso, Frozen Grape, Blueberry & Lemon Balm Frost Smoothie
recipes.summary: Refreshing violet frost smoothie pairing chilled shiso and lemon balm tea with frozen purple grapes, wild blueberries, ripe banana, and silky flaxseed oil.

ingredient_details.item: fresh green or red shiso leaves

steps: Steep shiso and lemon balm in hot water covered 4 minutes, strain cleanly, and cool briefly.
Add the herbal infusion, frozen purple grapes, frozen wild blueberries, banana, and flaxseed oil to a blender.
Blend 50 seconds until smooth, frosty, and deep purple.
tips: Both shiso and lemon balm bring gentle citrus-mint calm without any caffeine.
Freezing washed seedless grapes in a zip bag makes instant smoothie ice.

recipes.title: Ruby Shiso, Pressed Raspberry, Sweet Orange & Ginger Refresher
recipes.summary: Brilliant ruby Japanese-inspired refresher layering steeped shiso, fresh ginger, and spearmint with freshly squeezed sweet orange juice and strained crushed raspberries.

ingredient_details.item: fresh red or green shiso leaves (or 1 tsp dried)

steps: Steep shiso leaves, spearmint, and fresh ginger coins in hot water covered 4 minutes, then strain cleanly.
Mash raspberries gently with a fork and press through a fine mesh strainer into an ice-filled glass.
Pour in freshly squeezed orange juice and the strained shiso-ginger-spearmint infusion, stir gently, and enjoy chilled.
tips: Red shiso creates a breathtaking sunset-crimson drink alongside raspberries and sweet orange.
Zero added sugar—naturally vibrant and refreshing.

recipes.title: Emerald Shiso, Crisp Celery Stalk, White Grape & Spearmint Press
recipes.summary: Ultra-clean emerald press blending crisp celery stalk, fresh green shiso leaves, spearmint, mild fresh ginger, and chilled white grape juice, strained crystal-smooth over ice.
steps: Combine chopped celery stalks, fresh green shiso, spearmint, ginger, white grape juice, and cold water in a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until completely fine and bright emerald.
Press through a fine mesh strainer with the back of a spoon into a glass over ice cubes.
tips: White grape juice balances clean celery stalk with natural orchard sweetness.
No dedicated juicer required—rinse the blender and strainer right away for 1-minute cleanup.

recipes.title: Botanical Shiso, Tart Cherry, Cantaloupe & Lemon Balm Cooler
recipes.summary: Silky coral-ruby cooler pairing freshly blended and strained cantaloupe juice with pure tart cherry juice and a chilled steep of shiso and lemon balm leaves.

ingredient_details.item: fresh red or green shiso leaves

steps: Steep shiso and lemon balm in hot water covered 4 minutes, then strain cleanly.
Blend cantaloupe cubes 20 seconds and strain smoothly into an ice-filled glass.
Pour in pure tart cherry juice and the strained shiso-lemon balm infusion, stir lightly, and serve cold.
tips: Sweet cantaloupe juice softens tart cherry into a silky, relaxing evening drink.
Naturally caffeine-free and soothing before bedtime.

recipes.title: Iced Shiso, Smooth Black Tea, Sweet Orange & Spearmint Spritz
recipes.summary: Crisp iced herbal black tea steeped briefly with shiso leaves, spearmint, and fresh ginger coins, finished over ice with sweet orange juice and sparkling water.
steps: Steep black tea, fresh shiso, spearmint, and ginger slices in hot water covered 3 minutes, then strain cleanly.
Pour the strained tea and freshly squeezed orange juice over a glass filled with ice cubes.
Top with chilled sparkling water and stir once gently.
tips: A 3-minute brew keeps black tea crisp and amber so citrus and shiso shine through.
Swap in decaf black tea anytime you want an evening spritz.

recipes.title: Violet Shiso, Purple Grape, Crushed Blueberry & Sweet Basil Press
recipes.summary: Jewel-violet botanical cooler pairing lightly muddled blueberries and chilled purple grape juice with a crisp steeped infusion of fresh shiso and sweet basil leaves.

ingredient_details.item: fresh red or green shiso leaves

steps: Steep fresh shiso and sweet basil leaves in hot water covered 4 minutes, then strain cleanly.
Crush blueberries gently with a fork and press their violet juice through a fine strainer into an ice-filled glass.
Add purple grape juice and the strained shiso-basil infusion, stir gently, and enjoy chilled.
tips: Sweet basil and shiso share fragrant botanical notes that elevate dark berries and grape juice.
Thawed frozen wild blueberries release intense deep-violet juice with almost no pressing effort.
